guide.bunnidogs.title: Bunnidogs Guide
guide.bunnidogs.page.2.title: Start playing
guide.bunnidogs.page.2.body: Empty hands open animal and station controls. Feed two adults guavas. Plant their seed on farmland; break the ripe crop to hatch pups. This book is optional reference. Warrens: 46.
guide.bunnidogs.page.3.title: Genes and stats
guide.bunnidogs.page.3.body: Each of seven genes has two copies. Dominance picks the visible trait; hidden copies still pass to pups. Bred stat points are separate. Use Calipers to read both.
guide.bunnidogs.page.4.title: Breed a seed
guide.bunnidogs.page.4.body: Feed each of two ready adults a guava, or choose Courtship in their panels. They drop one litter seed and then rest. Its tooltip shows litter size and quality; Calipers forecasts inheritance.
guide.bunnidogs.page.5.title: Hatch the litter
guide.bunnidogs.page.5.body: Plant a seed on farmland; dispensers plant into air above it. Bone meal speeds growth; hand or dispenser Starlit Dust ripens it. Break the ripe crop to hatch pups. Fortune improves quality. Leave room.
guide.bunnidogs.page.6.title: Guava quality
guide.bunnidogs.page.6.body: Better guavas improve inherited stat gains. Feed both parents: their qualities are averaged. Golden: 1, Diamond: 2, Netherite: 4, Star: 7, Beacon: 12, Dragon Egg: 20.
guide.bunnidogs.page.7.title: Keep a pedigree
guide.bunnidogs.page.7.body: Log animals with a Pedigree Book; Ear Tags label them. Sneak-use with a filled basket to log its animal. Normal use opens records. Filter by traits, tags or senses>=20. Name recorded lines: page 95.
guide.bunnidogs.page.8.title: Nests and travel
guide.bunnidogs.page.8.body: Adults claim reachable Nests and return at night. Lead one to a free Nest, open it and choose Assign led adult. Each adult needs one Nest. A compass on a Nest or resident marks the way home.
guide.bunnidogs.page.9.title: Food and troughs
guide.bunnidogs.page.9.body: Guavas suit every line; other foods follow Diet. Troughs heal injured residents, including safe night meals within four blocks of home. Sneak-empty withdraws stock. Direct guava care: 87.
guide.bunnidogs.page.10.title: Life at home
guide.bunnidogs.page.10.body: Healthy adults visit nearby bells at noon. Ring one to call a daytime visit. Keep it within 12 blocks of home, with walking space. Injury, threats, leads, rides and night interrupt.
guide.bunnidogs.page.11.title: Gentle sampling
guide.bunnidogs.page.11.body: Use a Sampling Syringe on an animal at half health or better. It yields one Tissue Sample without harm; recovery takes five minutes. Sneak-use Calipers for care readiness and timers.
guide.bunnidogs.page.12.title: Wool and whiskers
guide.bunnidogs.page.12.body: Shear a healthy woolly adult for two wool in coat colors. Brush adults at Senses +10 for one whisker. Each needs ten minutes of recovery. Tools wear once; pups yield neither.
guide.bunnidogs.page.13.title: Useful coats
guide.bunnidogs.page.13.body: Expressed ember resists fire and lava; moss prevents Poison; sand prevents cactus damage; void prevents Levitation. Hidden copies give no protection. Other dangers still matter.
guide.bunnidogs.page.14.title: Physical traits
guide.bunnidogs.page.14.body: Hoofed legs halve fall damage. Slate adds 4 armor. Stocky/chonker resist knockback by 15%/30%. Snow walks on powder snow; snow/woolly resist freezing. Glow is self-lit. Hidden traits give no benefit.
guide.bunnidogs.page.15.title: Laboratory
guide.bunnidogs.page.15.body: Put two Tissue Samples on a Genetics Table: sheets, pup forecasts, copy odds and splice plans. Hoppers fill A then B and drain A first; power them to hold samples. Comparators: 0 / 8 / 15. Workshop: page 98.
guide.bunnidogs.page.16.title: Gene Splicer
guide.bunnidogs.page.16.body: Sneak-use to select a gene. Hold a donor sample in the other hand and carry Mutagen. Use on a healthy adult: one donor copy enters that gene. Costs one sample, Mutagen and tool use.
guide.bunnidogs.page.17.title: Stable lines
guide.bunnidogs.page.17.body: Register stable bred adults with matching copies in all seven genes and recorded parents. Use the Registry on an animal, or sneak-use with its filled basket in the other hand. Keeps 24 distinct lines.
guide.bunnidogs.page.18.title: Show Ring
guide.bunnidogs.page.18.body: Lead a stable bred adult to a Judging Stand. Use empty-handed or with a lead. Every stat needs +5 for bronze, +20 for silver, +50 for gold. Sneak-empty use previews; each tier pays only once.
guide.bunnidogs.page.19.title: Material drops
guide.bunnidogs.page.19.body: Death drops follow genes and bred points. Player kills unlock signatures and legends; pups give less. Pelts craft leather, sinew makes string, whiskers make Brushes and marrow makes Mutagen.
guide.bunnidogs.page.20.title: The five legends
guide.bunnidogs.page.20.body: At stat +100, adult player kills can drop a legend. Vitality: Titan Haunch; speed: Gilded Foot; Leap: Moon Sinew; Senses: Listening Shell; Bloom: Everbloom. More points improve the chance.
guide.bunnidogs.page.21.title: Apex ritual
guide.bunnidogs.page.21.body: Craft an Apex Crucible from seven obsidian, a Mutant Marrow and a diamond. Put all five distinct legends on Trophy Pedestals in its ring. Offer a Tissue Sample to choose the boss line.
guide.bunnidogs.page.22.title: The ritual ring
guide.bunnidogs.page.22.body: Use any five slots: three blocks N/E/S/W or two blocks diagonally, at crucible height. Leave dry space above it. Success spends the sample and five legends. The living donor stays safe.
guide.bunnidogs.page.23.title: Apex of the Line
guide.bunnidogs.page.23.body: Watch for its charge: dodge pounces and leave the four-block stomp. Half health enrages it. A player victory drops a crest that reads the original line or stands on a pedestal. Care tools refuse.
guide.bunnidogs.page.24.title: Guava juice
guide.bunnidogs.page.24.body: Craft any guava with glass, or use a Juicer (93). Use a main-hand seed with juice off-hand to infuse. One seed makes one frozen bottle. Genes choose effects; seed quality and richer juice (94) improve them.

guide.bunnidogs.page.25.title: Trough gardening
guide.bunnidogs.page.25.body: Healthy adults harvest matching food at hoe-enabled troughs, then rest a minute. Bloom +10 grows unripe crops. Diet, filters and mob griefing apply. Berries regrow; cactus pruning: page 57.
guide.bunnidogs.page.26.title: Furnished warrens
guide.bunnidogs.page.26.body: New dens have a trough with two guavas; levels 3-5 may fit a central bell. Grand-tree nurseries may fit an empty Cradle. New farm corners have empty enabled troughs. Use a hoe to enable work on crafted or old troughs.

guide.bunnidogs.page.27.body: Hold Calipers in the main hand and a Tissue Sample in the other. Use an Apex Crucible for health, attacks and defenses. Empty-hand use lists missing offerings. Reading spends nothing.

guide.bunnidogs.page.28.title: Living harvests
guide.bunnidogs.page.28.body: Brush healthy adults: glow gives glowstone; starborn at Bloom +20 gives Starlit Dust; moss at Bloom +10 gives moss carpet. Senses +10 adds a whisker. Gather one of each match for one tool use and ten-minute recovery.
guide.bunnidogs.page.29.title: Terrain traits
guide.bunnidogs.page.29.body: Hoofed adults step up one-block ledges and take half fall damage. Fleet legs reduce soul-sand and honey slowing by 25%; lean builds by 50%. Together: 75%. Cobwebs, Slowness and other hazards remain.
guide.bunnidogs.page.30.title: Shore fishing
guide.bunnidogs.page.30.body: Hurt fisher adults hunt nearby cod, salmon or tropical fish. They need a Nest, daylight and a reachable fish. A kill heals 4 HP, then rests 30 seconds. Pufferfish and land prey are excluded.
guide.bunnidogs.page.31.title: Resident needs
guide.bunnidogs.page.31.body: Sneak-use Calipers for a claimed Nest, distance, foods and meal recovery. Healthy adults need no healing. Ready means ready to search, not a promise of nearby food. Reading changes nothing.
guide.bunnidogs.page.32.title: Find refuge
guide.bunnidogs.page.32.body: Non-feral residents retreat from visible threats to a safer dry spot near home. Meals and work pause. Leads and rides take over. Feral lines keep their retaliation. No safe route means no retreat.
guide.bunnidogs.page.33.title: Storm shelter
guide.bunnidogs.page.33.body: Idle adults wait under cover near their Nest during thunderstorms. Leave a dry floor, room to stand and a safe route. Meals, work, danger and player control take priority. Normal rain keeps idle routines.
guide.bunnidogs.page.34.title: Trough automation
guide.bunnidogs.page.34.body: Hoppers fill and drain troughs. Power the hopper to hold food. Stock: one matching stack, up to 16; comparators read 0 empty to 15 full. A hoe toggles gardening. Redstone pauses residents: page 49.
guide.bunnidogs.page.35.title: Bell calls
guide.bunnidogs.page.35.body: Ring a bell within 12 blocks of a Nest to call healthy adults by day. Redstone and projectiles work too. Safe paths, leads and care take priority. Visits: 20 seconds, one-minute rest. Sneak-Calipers: roll call (page 52).
guide.bunnidogs.page.36.title: Fleece colors
guide.bunnidogs.page.36.body: Woolly adults yield two wool in their coat colors. Spotted gives one yellow and one brown. Glow gives cyan; moss green; ember red; void purple. Hidden coats add nothing. Calipers names the ready yield.

guide.bunnidogs.page.37.title: Trough filters
guide.bunnidogs.page.37.body: Sneak-use food to reserve a trough for that exact food and its components, without spending it. Hoppers and gardeners obey the filter. Sneak-empty withdraws stock; repeat while empty to clear the filter.
guide.bunnidogs.page.38.title: Care dispensers
guide.bunnidogs.page.38.body: Dispensers use Brushes or Sampling Syringes on one eligible bunnidog ahead per pulse. One tool use; hand and machine share recovery. Collect drops with hoppers. Armadillo brushing still works.

guide.bunnidogs.page.39.body: Craft six planks, leather and a lead into a basket. Pack one calm unled animal; release on clear dry ground. Identity and care rest persist; its old Nest becomes free. Calipers reads it. Stations: 82.

guide.bunnidogs.page.41.body: Craft wool, glass, a Nest and planks into a Nursery Cradle. Insert one seed; a loaded minute adds one stage. Bone meal helps; Starlit Dust ripens it. Sneak-empty withdraws and resets growth. Calipers reads the litter.
guide.bunnidogs.page.42.title: Hatch safely
guide.bunnidogs.page.42.body: Open a Cradle empty-handed and choose Hatch litter, or pulse redstone. The panel shows blocked pad coordinates. Clear a dry 3x3 pad ahead with two air blocks. Manual-only controls are in the panel too.

guide.bunnidogs.page.43.title: Surplus compost
guide.bunnidogs.page.43.body: Bloom +10 adults compost food above an eight-item reserve at hoe-enabled troughs. Place a composter nearby with a safe route. Crop work takes priority. Each job spends one food and rests a minute. Hoppers collect bone meal.

guide.bunnidogs.page.44.body: Use or dispense one Mutagen at a planted seed or occupied Cradle. Growth, incubation, parents, quality and item details stay intact. Treated or invalid litters keep the vial. You can treat a ripe litter before hatching.

guide.bunnidogs.page.45.body: Sneak-use a bone on a feral adult with a Nest to toggle guarding. No bone is spent. Free, half-healthy guards bite selected hostiles within eight blocks of home. Leads pause them. Calipers reports readiness. They can still be hurt.
guide.bunnidogs.page.46.title: Warren maps
guide.bunnidogs.page.46.body: Journeyman cartographers may sell a Warren Explorer Map for 14 emeralds and a compass. Follow its village marker to a natural Overworld warren. The trade is not guaranteed. Failed searches omit it. Cave dens and End warrens are excluded.

guide.bunnidogs.page.47.body: Sneak-use a compass on a half-healthy bat-eared adult with Senses +10. Marks ore through rock within six blocks. A survey rests 30 seconds, even when empty. Places stay after mining. Focused surveys: page 48.
message.bunnidogs.scouting.focus_require: Focused mineral surveys need at least +%s bred Senses. Clear the mineral from the other hand for a general survey.
guide.bunnidogs.page.48.title: Choose a mineral
guide.bunnidogs.page.48.body: Senses +20 scouts can focus: hold a mineral in the other hand. Raw metals/ingots select their ore; coal, redstone, lapis, gems, quartz or netherite scrap select theirs. No mineral is spent. Every focus shares the same survey rest.
guide.bunnidogs.page.49.title: Pause trough work
guide.bunnidogs.page.49.body: Power a Feeding Trough to pause resident meals, crops and composting. Stock, filters, hoppers and comparator output still work. Remove power to resume at the next search. The hoe keeps its setting. Empty-hand inspection names the pause.
advancement.bunnidogs.standing_watch.des: Ask a feral adult with a Nest to guard its home.
advancement.bunnidogs.quiet_listener.des: Ask a bat-eared adult bred to Senses +10 to mark nearby ore on a compass.
advancement.bunnidogs.discerning_ear.des: Use a mineral cue with a Senses +20 bat-eared scout to find that ore family.
screen.bunnidogs.records.filter_help: Filter: trait/tag words or line:name; shown:bat, carried:glow, adult, pup; senses>=20, bloom<10 or speed=5. Space-separated terms all match. Clear to restore original record numbers and parent links.
message.bunnidogs.finder.name: Rename a spare Ear Tag to a code such as BD-3F7A2C, then sneak-use Calipers with it in the other hand.
message.bunnidogs.finder.none: %s: no loaded matching animal within %s blocks.
tooltip.bunnidogs.ear_tag.finder: Rename a spare to a code; sneak-use Calipers to find that animal
tooltip.bunnidogs.calipers.finder: Sneak-use the air with a code-named Ear Tag opposite: find nearby matches
guide.bunnidogs.page.51.title: Find a tagged animal
guide.bunnidogs.page.51.body: Rename a spare Ear Tag to a code like BD-3F7A2C. Hold it opposite Calipers; sneak-use the air. Loaded matches within 24 blocks glow ten seconds. Search rest: five seconds. Reusable tag; packed animals are excluded.
message.bunnidogs.home_marker.none: This animal has no claimed Nest to mark.
message.bunnidogs.home_marker.missing: The recorded Nest is missing or outside this world.
message.bunnidogs.census.header: Bell roll call: %s loaded residents, %s injured. Nests within %s blocks; animals within %s.
message.bunnidogs.census.more: %s more loaded residents. The first eight are shown, injured first.
tooltip.bunnidogs.calipers.census: Sneak-use a bell: loaded resident roll call
guide.bunnidogs.page.52.title: Bell roll call
guide.bunnidogs.page.52.body: Sneak-use Calipers on a bell for loaded adults with nearby Nests. Lists tags, health, foods and homes; injured first. Shows up to eight animals within 32 blocks, with Nests within 12. Reading rings no bell and changes nothing.
message.bunnidogs.recovery_rest.health: Only serious injury (below half health) needs rest
message.bunnidogs.recovery_rest.outside_: Must first return inside its home boundary
message.bunnidogs.recovery_rest.ready: Ready to seek a safe spot near its Nest; meals take priority
guide.bunnidogs.page.53.title: Recovery rest
guide.bunnidogs.page.53.body: Adults below half health rest near their Nest instead of strolling by day. Food, danger, storms, breeding and leads take priority. Keep a dry safe route. Rest heals nothing; stock suitable food. Sneak-Calipers reports readiness.
tooltip.bunnidogs.guava.table: Hold while reading a Genetics Table to preview the feed quality
tooltip.bunnidogs.mutagen.table: Hold while reading a Genetics Table to preview treatment without spending it
guide.bunnidogs.page.54.title: Plan a litter
guide.bunnidogs.page.54.body: Read a Genetics Table holding one guava for both parents, or two to average them. Mutagen previews treatment. Cues and samples are kept. Clear hands for plain, untreated plans. Starborn is included. Fortune: page 55.
guide.bunnidogs.page.55.title: Plan the harvest
guide.bunnidogs.page.55.body: Read the table with a Fortune tool in either hand. Uses the highest held level, adding 0.5 quality per level at crop harvest. An opposite guava or Mutagen also applies. Cues stay intact. Cradles get no Fortune bonus.
guide.bunnidogs.page.57.title: Cactus gardens
guide.bunnidogs.page.57.body: Hoe-enable a trough for desert-browser adults. They trim one spare cactus top, leaving lower segments. Keep clear ground and a safe route. Flowers stay intact. Diet, filters, power, protection and shared work rest apply.
guide.bunnidogs.page.58.title: Regional farms
guide.bunnidogs.page.58.body: New farms grow desert cactus, Nether wart, swamp mushrooms, cave glow berries or End chorus. Some fit an empty enabled trough. Stock it for meals. Old settlements keep their plans. End care: 81.
tooltip.bunnidogs.guava.plant: Use beneath leaves to grow a new hanging fruit
guide.bunnidogs.page.59.title: Guava orchards
guide.bunnidogs.page.59.body: Use one plain guava on the underside of leaves to plant green fruit in air. Any leaf type works. Bone meal adds one age; two ripen it. Pick ripe fruit to keep it growing. Shears or Silk Touch recover guava leaves for new orchards.
guide.bunnidogs.page.60.title: Mushroom beds
guide.bunnidogs.page.60.body: Healthy mushroom eaters thin red or brown beds beside an enabled trough. Another living mushroom of the same color must remain within three blocks. Keep mycelium and clear routes. Native spread regrows the patch; work rests a minute.
guide.bunnidogs.page.61.title: Fruit meals
guide.bunnidogs.page.61.body: Injured adult residents eat ripe hanging guavas near home by day. Matching Diets also pick sweet or glow berries. Plants stay to regrow. One meal heals 2 HP and shares the thirty-second food rest. Safe routes and protection apply.
guide.bunnidogs.page.62.title: Sapling stations
guide.bunnidogs.page.62.body: Dispensers plant guava saplings into air over valid soil. Blocked targets keep stock. Grass, podzol and mycelium work. Bone meal tries growth. Lost soil drops one sapling. Give the whole tree loaded space.
guide.bunnidogs.page.63.title: Underground farms
guide.bunnidogs.page.63.body: New five-tree cave and Nether warrens may fit a regional farm: glow berries under a trellis, or wart on soul sand. Plots need no water. A clear corner may fit an empty enabled trough. Existing settlements keep their plans.
guide.bunnidogs.page.64.title: Safe seedbeds
guide.bunnidogs.page.64.body: Plant litter seeds on farmland. If soil changes to dirt, grass, podzol or mycelium, the crop keeps its whole litter and continues growing. Lost support returns the saved seed. Changing soil never hatches it or resets its parents.
guide.bunnidogs.page.65.title: Snow-coat care
guide.bunnidogs.page.65.body: Brush healthy adult snow coats at Bloom +10 in a snowy climate for one snowball. Whiskers and Starlit Dust can combine under shared ten-minute rest. Shears gather wool separately. Home routes: page 88.
message.bunnidogs.care.gathering_bonus: Senses +%s: gathers old loose matching food beside enabled troughs.
message.bunnidogs.care.gathering_require: Needs Senses +%s to gather loose food into enabled troughs.
guide.bunnidogs.page.67.title: Loose food meals
guide.bunnidogs.page.67.body: Injured adults eat ordinary loose food near home by day after ten seconds. Diet, pickup delays and owner reservations apply. Upgraded guavas stay. One item heals 2 HP; food rest is thirty seconds. Keep a dry clear route.
guide.bunnidogs.page.68.title: Trough gathering
guide.bunnidogs.page.68.body: Healthy adults at Senses +10 move one old loose matching food into a nearby hoe-enabled trough by day. Diet, filters, power and safe routes apply. Collection shares the one-minute garden rest. Loose meals: page 67.
guide.bunnidogs.page.69.title: Melon beds
guide.bunnidogs.page.69.body: Healthy foragers and omnivores harvest a slice beside a living attached melon stem, near an enabled trough. The stem regrows fruit; decorative melons stay. Slices heal or grow matching lines. Stems: 70. Farms: 78.
guide.bunnidogs.page.70.title: Grow melon stems
guide.bunnidogs.page.70.body: Bloom +10 grows a young melon stem by one age at an enabled trough. No food is made. Mature stems await native fruit growth; leave nearby soil and air. Meadow stores may hold seeds. All jobs share one-minute garden rest.
guide.bunnidogs.page.71.title: Orchard pickers
guide.bunnidogs.page.71.body: A dispenser with shears picks one ripe hanging guava and resets it to green for one tool use. Unripe fruit keeps the tool. Hoppers collect drops; shears still work on animals and beehives. Repair gaps: page 74.
guide.bunnidogs.page.72.title: Habitat meals
guide.bunnidogs.page.72.body: Injured matching lines eat spare cactus tops, extra same-color mushrooms, ripe wart or stem-linked melons near home by day. Growing stock stays. No trough is needed. A meal heals 2 HP and shares thirty-second food rest. Predators: 80.
guide.bunnidogs.page.73.title: Nest signals
guide.bunnidogs.page.73.body: Read a Nest with a comparator: 15 means claimed, 0 means free. The resident can be away or unloaded. Rehoming updates both Nests. Packing into a Travel Basket or death frees the old one.
guide.bunnidogs.page.74.title: Repair a canopy
guide.bunnidogs.page.74.body: A dispenser plants one plain guava into an empty dry gap beneath leaves. Other targets eject the guava as food, so pulse once to repair a canopy. Upgraded guavas never plant fruit. Bone meal grows it; shears pick it.
message.bunnidogs.trough.mode_set: Work: %s (enabled). Hoe: toggle; sneak-hoe: next mode.
message.bunnidogs.care.nursery_bonus: Bloom +%s: Nursery mode spends one plain guava above %s food to tend one Cradle stage
message.bunnidogs.care.nursery_requireme: Breed Bloom to +%s for Nursery work; keep more than %s plain guavas
guide.bunnidogs.page.75.title: Work modes
guide.bunnidogs.page.75.body: Sneak-hoe a trough to cycle Mixed, Garden, Gather, Compost, Nursery and Supply. Normal hoe toggles work; power pauses it. Garden replants. Pause one resident: 85. Specialist jobs: 84.
guide.bunnidogs.page.76.title: Restore a garden
guide.bunnidogs.page.76.body: Garden mode: Bloom +10 residents spend one suitable food above an eight-item reserve to replant a valid gap. Use the plant's normal soil or support. Carrots, guavas and berries are examples. Jobs share one-minute work rest.
guide.bunnidogs.page.77.title: Nursery workers
guide.bunnidogs.page.77.body: Nursery mode: Bloom +20 adults spend one plain guava above an eight-food reserve for one Cradle stage. The whole litter stays. Jobs share garden rest. Players or redstone hatch ripe litters.
guide.bunnidogs.page.78.title: Meadow melon farms
guide.bunnidogs.page.78.body: Fresh five-tree meadow farms mix young melon stems with ordinary crops. Empty dirt spaces allow fruit; a clear corner may fit an enabled trough. Plants grow naturally. Old settlements keep their plans. Garden repair: page 76.

message.bunnidogs.work.hint: Leave a clear route and the required plants, loose food, composter or Cradle nearby.
guide.bunnidogs.page.79.title: Work roll call
guide.bunnidogs.page.79.body: Sneak-use Calipers on a trough for its mode, food, filter and nearby residents. The report explains age, health, home, traits, recovery and stock limits. Ready means eligible to search. Leave a clear route and the right work nearby.
guide.bunnidogs.page.80.title: Safe hunting
guide.bunnidogs.page.80.body: Wounded hunters and fishers follow dry home routes to wild prey. They stop for unsafe terrain, changed homes or protection. Named, leashed and transported animals stay. One kill heals 4 HP and shares thirty-second food rest.
message.bunnidogs.care.chorus_bonus: Bloom +%s: revive spent chorus flowers for one fruit, keeping the plant
message.bunnidogs.care.chorus_requiremen: Breed Bloom to +%s to revive spent chorus flowers
guide.bunnidogs.page.81.title: Chorus gardens
guide.bunnidogs.page.81.body: Bloom +20 chorus eaters revive spent flowers for one fruit. Mixed/Garden troughs store it; injured adults eat it for 2 HP. Living flowers keep their branch age. Leave supported branches and dry paths.
guide.bunnidogs.page.82.title: Basket stations
guide.bunnidogs.page.82.body: A dispenser packs one calm unled bunnidog ahead. Filled baskets release onto clear dry ground. Failed pulses keep the basket. Identity and care rest persist. Each pulse acts once; sort with hoppers.
message.bunnidogs.work.supply_food: needs more than %s ordinary food to supply another trough
message.bunnidogs.care.supplying_bonus: Senses +%s: Supply mode moves one surplus food while keeping %s in reserve
message.bunnidogs.care.supplying_require: Breed Senses to +%s for Supply work; keep more than %s ordinary food
guide.bunnidogs.page.83.title: Supply the troughs
guide.bunnidogs.page.83.body: Supply mode: Senses +20 adults move one ordinary surplus food to a nearby non-Supply trough below eight food, keeping eight at source. Keep both unpowered with dry paths. One job shares the one-minute work rest.
message.bunnidogs.work.resumed: Resident chores resumed when healthy and ready.
message.bunnidogs.gardening.paused: Paused by keeper; sneak-use a hoe on this resident to resume
message.bunnidogs.cradle.manual_only: Manual hatching only. Sneak-hoe to enable redstone; incubation continues.
message.bunnidogs.cradle.redstone_enable: Redstone hatching enabled. Sneak-hoe for manual only; a fresh pulse hatches ripe litters.
message.bunnidogs.cradle.ready_manual: Ripe litter: open the Cradle and choose Hatch litter. Redstone hatching is disabled.
guide.bunnidogs.page.85.title: Pause a resident
guide.bunnidogs.page.85.body: Sneak-use a hoe on a resident to pause or resume chores, with no wear. Meals, breeding and home routines continue. Pups can keep the preference. Calipers shows the pause; Travel Baskets preserve it.
guide.bunnidogs.page.86.title: Cradle controls
guide.bunnidogs.page.86.body: Open a Cradle for Hatch litter and manual-only controls. Sneak-hoe also toggles redstone hatching. Growth and nursery work continue. Re-enable redstone before sending a fresh hatch pulse.
message.bunnidogs.feeding.plain_care: Use a plain guava for direct care. Normal feeding spends upgraded guavas on breeding.
message.bunnidogs.feeding.no_care: This adult needs no healing. Normal guava feeding starts breeding.
tooltip.bunnidogs.guava.care: Sneak-feed for healing or pup growth; normal feed breeds
guide.bunnidogs.page.87.title: Guava hand care
guide.bunnidogs.page.87.body: Sneak-feed a plain guava to heal 2 HP and help pups grow without starting breeding. Healthy adults keep it; upgraded guavas stay for breeding. Existing love quality and rests stay. Normal feeding breeds.
guide.bunnidogs.page.88.title: Snow surface routes
guide.bunnidogs.page.88.body: Snow-footed residents cross powder-snow surfaces on home routes. Woolly or hidden snow gives no footing. Deep powder and other hazards stay blocked. Lost footing or floors interrupt jobs. Keep dry room above.
message.bunnidogs.phasing.ready: Ready after a nonlethal attack; needs safe nearby ground.
message.bunnidogs.phasing.transported: Paused while led or carrying/riding passengers.
guide.bunnidogs.page.90.title: Phase legs
guide.bunnidogs.page.90.body: End founders may express Phase legs. After a nonlethal attack, grounded adults blink 3-6 blocks to safe dry ground, farther from danger. Recovery: 20 seconds. Leads, rides and passengers prevent it. Damage still lands.
guide.bunnidogs.page.91.title: Webbed paws
guide.bunnidogs.page.91.body: Swamp webbed legs add 50% water propulsion but still need air. Land speed and jumps are slightly lower. Toe membranes show only when expressed. Breed or splice them into other coats. Home work keeps dry routes.
guide.bunnidogs.page.92.title: Fertility marks
guide.bunnidogs.page.92.body: Tail tips show fertility: average bare; prolific one rosette; shy a green bud; swarm three rosettes; starborn a violet star. Pups show them too. Marks show expressed genes, not readiness.
tooltip.bunnidogs.juice.carrier: Infusion quality floor: %s. Seed genes and drift stay the same.
tooltip.bunnidogs.juice.infuse: Use a seed with this bottle off-hand, or load a Juicer.
message.bunnidogs.juicer.inserted: Loaded %s. Top: fruit/seed; side: bottle/juice; bottom: result.
message.bunnidogs.juicer.inputs: Load guava + bottle, or a valid seed + uninfused juice.
message.bunnidogs.jar.empty: Insert a Tissue Sample. Use to read; sneak with both hands empty to recover it.
screen.bunnidogs.lineage.name: Name lineage
screen.bunnidogs.lineage.hint: Up to 40 characters; empty clears the name.
screen.bunnidogs.lineage.local: Names belong to this book’s exact genotype.
screen.bunnidogs.lineage.stale: Book changed. Reopen it before editing.
screen.bunnidogs.lineage.invalid: Use 40 characters or fewer, without formatting.
guide.bunnidogs.page.93.title: The Juicer
guide.bunnidogs.page.93.body: Load guava + bottle, or seed + juice. A pair takes 5 seconds; power pauses. Hoppers feed fruit/seed above and bottles/juice beside, then drain below. Empty-hand takes output; sneak-empty recovers inputs.
guide.bunnidogs.page.94.title: Richer juice
guide.bunnidogs.page.94.body: All eight guava tiers make juice. Infusion uses the higher seed or juice quality. The seed still decides genes and inherited stat drift. Uninfused drinks only restore hunger; save rich juice for infusion.
guide.bunnidogs.page.95.title: Name a lineage
guide.bunnidogs.page.95.body: Open a Pedigree Book or Registry, choose a record, then Name lineage. Limit: 40 characters; empty clears. Names label that exact genome in this book. Search line:name. Re-logging keeps names; animals stay unchanged.
guide.bunnidogs.page.96.title: Pelt rugs
guide.bunnidogs.page.96.body: Two matching pelts and string craft one coat rug. All 13 coats keep their colors and patterns. Place on a supported floor; removing support drops the rug. Mixed pelts still craft leather without string.
guide.bunnidogs.page.97.title: Specimen Jars
guide.bunnidogs.page.97.body: Insert a Tissue Sample to show its coat; use to read the full sheet. Sneak with both hands empty to recover it. Breaking drops jar and sample. Comparator: 0 empty; 1 plus 2 per fixed gene pair, up to 15.
message.bunnidogs.pen.ready: Ready. Open the Pen and choose Feed both parents, or pulse redstone.
message.bunnidogs.pen.too_far: Bring both adults within four blocks, and less than three blocks apart.
message.bunnidogs.pen.unavailable: Both adults need full health, no love/rest, no danger, leads or rides.
message.bunnidogs.pen.home: Each parent needs a real nearby claimed Nest.
message.bunnidogs.pen.unsafe: Keep both parents on safe dry ground with a clear view of each other.
message.bunnidogs.pen.unloaded: Keep the twelve-block surrounding area loaded.
message.bunnidogs.pen.protected: Automatic feeding was refused by mob-griefing protection.
message.bunnidogs.pen.empty: Load guavas into A (front left) and B (front right).
message.bunnidogs.pen.changed: The pair or pen changed; no new feeding started.
message.bunnidogs.pen.fed: Fed one guava each. Normal courtship produces the litter seed.
message.bunnidogs.pen.need_pair: Keep exactly two ordinary adults in the twelve-block pen area.
tooltip.bunnidogs.seed.quality_band: Color band: %s. Stored quality; Fortune is added at harvest.
guide.bunnidogs.page.99.title: Breeding Pen
guide.bunnidogs.page.99.body: Open empty-handed for stock, parent status and Feed both parents. Load guavas by using each side. Parents need full health, separate Nests and a safe close pairing area. The panel explains refusals. Redstone also feeds.
guide.bunnidogs.page.100.title: Seed quality colors
guide.bunnidogs.page.100.body: Seed bands: plain 0, gold 1, diamond 2, netherite 4, star 7, beacon 12, egg 20, command 33. Fractions use the lower band. Tooltips give exact quality. Fortune adds quality at harvest. Stored genes and Mutagen stay intact.
tooltip.bunnidogs.pen.ports: Hoppers: top feeds A; sides feed B. Collect litter seeds on the floor.

message.bunnidogs.camouflage.disturbed: needs full health, calm, dry footing and no cargo, transport or glowing effect
message.bunnidogs.camouflage.blended: blended on %s; half visual range and no walking vibrations
advancements.bunnidogs.barn.title: Old Breeding Grounds
tooltip.bunnidogs.detector.controls: Use a sample to copy genes. Empty-hand switches exact/analog; sneak-empty clears.
message.bunnidogs.detector.unloaded: front pad is unloaded or outside the world border
message.bunnidogs.detector.blocked: keep the front block and its headroom empty
message.bunnidogs.detector.absent: no animal centered on the front pad
message.bunnidogs.detector.crowded: use exactly one animal on the front pad
message.bunnidogs.detector.unavailable: unavailable; the Apex cannot be sorted
guide.bunnidogs.page.102.title: Coat camouflage
guide.bunnidogs.page.102.body: Healthy calm grounded coats blend: half visual range, no walking vibrations. Injury, danger, love, Glowing, water, cargo and transport break cover. Other vibrations still reach sculk.
guide.bunnidogs.page.103.title: Matching ground
guide.bunnidogs.page.103.body: Tan/cream/sand: sand. Brown/spotted: earth. Moss: green cover. Snow: snow. Pale/slate: light/dark stone. Ember: netherrack. Void: obsidian or purpur. Glow cannot blend. Calipers shows cover.
guide.bunnidogs.page.104.title: The Breeder
guide.bunnidogs.page.104.body: An unemployed adult villager claims a Breeding Pen job site. Animal Nests stay separate. Trading locks the career; native restocks and discounts apply. Your Pen still pays its own guavas.
guide.bunnidogs.page.105.title: Breeder supplies
guide.bunnidogs.page.105.body: Novice: 20 guavas for 1 emerald; 1 emerald for 4 tags, 2 for a guide. Apprentice: 4 local pelts for 1 emerald; syringe costs 4. Journeyman: 8 sinew for 1 emerald; Pen costs 10.
guide.bunnidogs.page.106.title: Expert trades
guide.bunnidogs.page.106.body: Expert: Juicer 12 emeralds; golden guava 8. Master: diamond guava 32 emeralds + 4 diamonds; Splicer 24 emeralds + 1 Mutant Marrow. Prices vary. Stock renews at work.
guide.bunnidogs.page.107.title: Abandoned barns
guide.bunnidogs.page.107.body: New dry clearings may hold rare barns: empty tools, two Nests and one supply chest. Repair the broken rail. Cartographers may sell Barn Explorer Maps for 10 emeralds + a compass.
guide.bunnidogs.page.108.title: Gene comparator
guide.bunnidogs.page.108.body: Use a sample to copy genes for free. Keep the front block and headroom empty, with one animal on the pad. Seven matching gene pairs give 15. Hidden copies count; pair order, stats and age do not.
guide.bunnidogs.page.109.title: Genetic circuits
guide.bunnidogs.page.109.body: Empty-hand switches exact/analog; sneak with both hands empty clears. Analog: 1 + 2 per matched pair. Missing, blocked or crowded pads give 0. Checks each half second. Calipers inspects.
message.bunnidogs.packs.stock: Carrying %s / %s bundles. Sneak with both hands empty to retrieve the last.
message.bunnidogs.packs.protected: Build permission is needed to equip bundles.
message.bunnidogs.packs.unavailable: Only living ordinary bunnidogs can carry bundles.
message.bunnidogs.packs.adult: Wait until this bunnidog grows up to equip a bundle.
message.bunnidogs.packs.danger: Wait until this bunnidog is calm and out of love or danger.
message.bunnidogs.packs.full: This build is carrying its limit. Retrieve a bundle before adding another.
message.bunnidogs.packs.overloaded: Carrying %s / %s bundles; overloaded, %s%% slower. Retrieve bundles to recover speed.
guide.bunnidogs.page.110.title: Bundle carriers
guide.bunnidogs.page.110.body: Adults carry bundles: slim/lean 1, average 2, stocky/woolly 3, chonker 4. Use a bundle to equip it. Sneak with both hands empty to retrieve the last. Empty-hand inspects. Cargo safety: 111.
guide.bunnidogs.page.111.title: Cargo safety
guide.bunnidogs.page.111.body: Saves and baskets retain whole bundles. Smaller builds keep excess: each extra slows movement 25%, up to 75%. Retrieve to recover speed. Cargo breaks camouflage and drops as equipment on death.
advancements.bunnidogs.regional_kennel.d: Find a regional kennel and its ready-to-stock breeding yard
advancements.bunnidogs.show_ring.title: The Showground
advancements.bunnidogs.show_ring.descrip: Find a public Show Ring arena
guide.bunnidogs.page.113.title: Regional kennels
guide.bunnidogs.page.113.body: Meadow, desert and snowy kennels have an intact yard, two floor Nests, a bed, care tools and supplies. Bring your own animals. The empty Pen can become a villager job site.
guide.bunnidogs.page.114.title: The pairing yard
guide.bunnidogs.page.114.body: Lead two adults home to the sheltered Nests. Stock both Pen mangers with guavas. Open the Pen and choose Feed both parents, or pulse it. Other adults within 12 blocks stop pairing. Courtship makes the seed.
guide.bunnidogs.page.115.title: Show Ring arenas
guide.bunnidogs.page.115.body: Rare clearings hold a public stand, two holding bays and three empty trophy pedestals. Lead your entrant to the gold floor mark near the stand. Normal judging rules apply. Ribbons stay earned.
guide.bunnidogs.page.116.title: Venue maps
guide.bunnidogs.page.116.body: Cartographers may sell Kennel Explorer Maps at journeyman for 12 emeralds + compass, Showground Maps at expert for 16 + compass. Look in new dry clearings. Native prices vary; repair around obstacles.

guide.bunnidogs.page.118.title: Island refuge
guide.bunnidogs.page.118.body: Mild-ocean refuges hold three coastal founders, sheltered Nests, guavas and supplies. Expert cartographers may sell maps for 20 emeralds + compass. Explore new chunks; bring a basket or lead.
guide.bunnidogs.page.119.title: Coastal genes
guide.bunnidogs.page.119.body: Seal fur normally doubles air on average. Paddle feet normally double water propulsion, with shorter legs on land. Both breed into other lines. Still needs air; hidden copies give no benefit.
guide.bunnidogs.page.120.title: Shore meals
guide.bunnidogs.page.120.body: Shore foragers eat kelp, dried kelp and seagrass. Injured adults trim upper kelp from dry home banks by day. Roots stay and water returns. Healing shares normal meal rest; mob-griefing applies.
guide.bunnidogs.page.121.title: Kelp workers
guide.bunnidogs.page.121.body: Healthy housed shore residents trim upper kelp into a nearby enabled trough. Opt in with a hoe. Keep a two-block stalk and reachable dry bank. Roots stay; natural growth supplies the next top.
guide.bunnidogs.page.122.title: Restore a tide bed
guide.bunnidogs.page.122.body: Choose Garden mode with a sneaking hoe. Bloom +10 workers spend one kelp on a bare bed under two blocks of still water, keeping eight in stock. They stay dry and leave living stems to regrow.
guide.bunnidogs.page.123.title: Pale cave guide
guide.bunnidogs.page.123.body: In dim light, sneak-feed a calm pale adult with Senses +20 one glow berry for 60 seconds of Night Vision. Needs half health; rests 30 seconds. Existing vision keeps the berry. Saves keep recovery.
guide.bunnidogs.page.124.title: Genetic discoveries
guide.bunnidogs.page.124.body: Log a bred animal carrying a mutation-only allele: Nature Finds a Way. Keep all eight wild origins in one book: Wild Gene Library. Hidden copies count; unlogged parents do not. Rewards pay XP once.

guide.bunnidogs.page.126.title: Train a trail partner
guide.bunnidogs.page.126.body: Craft a Whistle with copper, two string or Sinew, and a feather or Whisker. Open a calm loyal/stoic adult and choose Train with the tool and one plain guava in your inventory. Direct whistle use still works.
guide.bunnidogs.page.127.title: Trail orders
guide.bunnidogs.page.127.body: Open your partner empty-handed for Follow, Wait and Return home. A whistle still switches Follow/Wait; air calls Follow, sneak-air returns home. Sneak-whistle on the animal releases training.
guide.bunnidogs.page.128.title: Safe trail journeys
guide.bunnidogs.page.128.body: Trail orders pause home chores. Following walks dry paths; danger and transport take priority. Phase still escapes real attacks. Training and cargo travel in baskets; baskets clear the old home as usual.
guide.bunnidogs.page.129.title: Whistle calls
guide.bunnidogs.page.129.body: Calls reach at most 16 partners. Hearing follows ears and Senses, 8-32 blocks; calls rest two seconds. A follower waits ten seconds for a lost keeper, then resumes residence. Wait stays until changed.
guide.bunnidogs.page.131.title: Breeder commissions
guide.bunnidogs.page.131.body: Open the Board empty-handed to choose a request and see each candidate requirement. Bring a real Breeder and one calm bred adult to the clear front pad. Submit one paper from the panel or by hand; rewards pay once.
guide.bunnidogs.page.132.title: Night Guide
guide.bunnidogs.page.132.body: Fix pale coat and bat ears; breed Senses +20. Bring the parented adult to a staffed Board with one paper. Night Guide pays 4 emeralds, 8 glow berries and 50 XP once per keeper. Your animal stays.
guide.bunnidogs.page.133.title: Coastal Scout
guide.bunnidogs.page.133.body: Fix seal coat, paddle legs and shore-forager Diet; breed Senses +10 and Swiftness +10. Coastal Scout pays 6 emeralds, a lead, 8 dried kelp and 50 XP once. Board rules apply; keep the animal.
guide.bunnidogs.page.134.title: Mountain Courier
guide.bunnidogs.page.134.body: Fix hoofed legs and a Build that carries 3 or 4 bundles. Breed Leap +20 and Swiftness +10; equip one bundle. Mountain Courier pays 6 emeralds, a bundle and 50 XP once. Keep all cargo.
guide.bunnidogs.page.135.title: Ember Gardener
guide.bunnidogs.page.135.body: Fix ember coat and nether-forager Diet; breed Bloom +10. Ember Gardener pays 4 emeralds, 8 nether wart, 4 bone meal and 50 XP once at a staffed Board. Bring a calm bred adult; keep the animal.
guide.bunnidogs.page.136.title: Frost Steward
guide.bunnidogs.page.136.body: Fix snow coat, tiny ears and fisher Diet; breed Bloom +10 and Vitality +20. Frost Steward pays 4 emeralds, 4 snowballs, 8 cod and 50 XP once. The snow coat also supports cold-climate care.
guide.bunnidogs.page.137.title: Desert Messenger
guide.bunnidogs.page.137.body: Fix fennec ears, fleet legs and lean Build; breed Swiftness +20 and Senses +10. Desert Messenger pays 6 emeralds, 4 string, a lead and 50 XP once. Lean runners still trade health for speed.
guide.bunnidogs.page.138.title: Swamp Herbalist
guide.bunnidogs.page.138.body: Fix moss coat, webbed legs and mushroom-eater Diet; breed Bloom +10 and Senses +10. Swamp Herbalist pays 4 emeralds, 4 bone meal, 4 moss blocks and 50 XP once. Keep your living harvest line.
guide.bunnidogs.page.139.title: End Nursery
guide.bunnidogs.page.139.body: Fix void coat, phase legs, starborn fertility and chorus-eater Diet; breed Bloom +20. End Nursery pays 6 emeralds, 4 chorus fruit, 2 Starlit Dust and 50 XP once. Native seed/work rules remain.
guide.bunnidogs.page.140.title: Crossing Branches
guide.bunnidogs.page.140.body: Fix all seven gene pairs and combine at least four wild origins; breed Senses +20. Crossing Branches pays 12 emeralds, a golden guava and 100 XP once. Common alleles add no wild origin. Animal stays.

care.bunnidogs.animal.next.courting: Bring another guava-fed adult close. Their courtship drops one litter seed.
care.bunnidogs.animal.next.rest: This parent is resting. Breeding food is kept until it is ready again.

care.bunnidogs.trough.next.ready: Injured nearby residents can eat. Crop work is optional; choose its purpose below.
care.bunnidogs.trough.mode.mixed: Mixed: harvest, tend, gather and compost surplus. Does not spend food planting new crops.
care.bunnidogs.trough.mode.garden: Garden: harvest and restore crops, spending suitable stock for new plantings.
care.bunnidogs.trough.mode.gather: Gather: carry nearby suitable dropped food into this Trough.
care.bunnidogs.trough.mode.compost: Compost: turn stock above the eight-item reserve into compost with Bloom +10.
care.bunnidogs.trough.mode.nursery: Nursery: Bloom +20 adults tend nearby Cradle stages with plain guavas, keeping eight in reserve.
care.bunnidogs.trough.mode.supply: Supply: Senses +20 adults move ordinary surplus to nearby compatible Troughs, keeping eight at source.
care.bunnidogs.trough.meals: Trough meals heal; they never start courtship. A hoe remains a quick work control.

care.bunnidogs.pen.next.ready: Both parents are ready. Feed both parents spends one guava from each manger.
care.bunnidogs.pen.next.pair: Bring exactly two adult residents; move other adults at least 12 blocks away.
care.bunnidogs.pen.next.too_far: Bring both parents within four blocks of the Pen and less than three blocks apart.
care.bunnidogs.pen.next.unavailable: Parents need full health, no breeding rest or danger, and freedom from leads, riders and water.
care.bunnidogs.pen.next.home: Give each parent its own Nest. Keep both parents within their home area.
care.bunnidogs.pen.next.unsafe: Clear a safe, dry floor and a visible path between the parents.
care.bunnidogs.pen.next.unloaded: Keep the whole pairing area nearby and loaded.
care.bunnidogs.pen.next.protected: Protection is preventing this automated pairing.
care.bunnidogs.pen.next.empty: Add a guava to each manger below. Using a guava on each side also works, including richer tiers.
care.bunnidogs.pen.next.changed: The pairing area changed. Check both parents and reopen the station.
care.bunnidogs.pen.next.busy: The station is already feeding a pair.
care.bunnidogs.pen.next.fed: The pair has been fed. Keep them together and collect their litter seed.
care.bunnidogs.cradle.next.seed: Insert a seed from your inventory below, or use a chosen seed on the Cradle. Farmland also works.
care.bunnidogs.cradle.next.grow: Let the seed grow, or use bone meal. Starlit Dust ripens it immediately.
care.bunnidogs.cradle.next.hatch: The litter is ripe and its landing pad is clear. Choose Hatch litter.
care.bunnidogs.cradle.next.space: Clear the dry 3 × 3 pad two blocks in front, with two air blocks above it. Keep animals out of the pad.
care.bunnidogs.cradle.grow: A loaded minute grows one stage. Withdrawing a seed resets its growth.
care.bunnidogs.juicer.next.power: Redstone power pauses the press. Remove the signal to continue.
care.bunnidogs.juicer.next.output: Collect the output to make room for another bottle.
care.bunnidogs.juicer.next.inputs: Add a guava and a glass bottle below, or use your chosen ingredients on the press. One of each makes juice.
care.bunnidogs.juicer.infuse: Optional infusion: one litter seed + uninfused juice. This spends the seed instead of hatching it.
care.bunnidogs.nest.one: One adult per Nest. Nearby adults can claim a free Nest naturally.
care.bunnidogs.nest.range: Residents return home at night and normally work within 16 blocks.
care.bunnidogs.nest.compass: Use a compass on this Nest to mark the way back.
care.bunnidogs.nest.next.claimed: Keep this resident’s floor and walking route clear. Leads and baskets take priority over home routines.
care.bunnidogs.nest.next.lead: Lead an adult within eight blocks, then choose Assign led adult. A lead used on the Nest also works.
